payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute suffix counts and max LNDS from each position; forward greedy: keep 0 as 0, change 1 to 0 only if it allows building max LNDS later.
payload.rationale: Greedy forward construction using precomputed DP to decide when a 1 can be turned into 0 without reducing any substring's LNDS. Proof relies on exchange argument: any optimal solution can be transformed by swapping 1 to 0 at safe positions.
